product.name: Due Diligence Automation Platform
product.description: A platform that automates and enhances due diligence on business customers by analyzing online presence, networks, and ongoing monitoring to identify risks.

product.name: Risk Assistant
product.description: A tool that investigates the nature of SMB customers and transaction counterparties by analyzing industry classification, addresses, and online presence risk signals.

product.name: Screening Assistant
product.description: A tool that automates the investigation of alerts from sanctions, PEP, and adverse media systems to reduce time spent on false positive remediation.

product.name: KYB Assistant
product.description: A tool that verifies business information and validates customer-uploaded documents to reduce onboarding friction.

product.description: An AI-driven cyber risk management product that helps organizations prioritize security decisions based on business impact.
